findings: September descriptions are 3.05 PDF points below the payment baseline. A fixed 3-point line tolerance separates them from the payment row.
The old extractor closes the row at the amount before collecting the offset description. Column inference then treats name fragments as descriptions.
Word extraction and text extraction previously produced different line lists, requiring two repair routines. One positioned-word stream now supplies both text and coordinates.
Word grouping uses half the font height. Tight word extraction prevents letters on adjacent source-label baselines from interleaving.
Column inference is scoped to the register month so different layouts in one packet cannot set each other's boundary.
iterations: Prototype single-stream font-relative row grouping: restored September descriptions; May through August CSVs unchanged.
